hero.subtitle: We are getting married
story.title: Our Story
story.quote: Love knows no borders, and our journey brings us to the heart of Puglia.
story.p1: We are so excited to celebrate our special day with you in beautiful Lecce! From our first meeting to all our travels together, everything led up to this moment.
story.p2: Lecce, the 'Florence of the South', captured our hearts with its Baroque architecture, warm hospitality, and delicious food. We warmly invite you to celebrate love with us on March 5, 2027.
program.title: The Schedule
program.item1.title: Ceremony
program.item1.desc: Guest arrival followed by the wedding ceremony in a historic church in the heart of Lecce.
program.item2.title: Aperitivo & Toast
program.item2.desc: Traditional Italian Aperitivo with local delicacies and Prosecco in the Masseria garden.
program.item3.title: Dinner
program.item3.desc: A multi-course dinner featuring the best of Pugliese cuisine and fine local wines.
program.item4.title: Party & Cake
program.item4.desc: Cake cutting, first dance, and partying late into the night with live music.
travel.title: Location & Travel Info
travel.flights.title: Flights to Puglia
travel.flights.desc: The closest airports are Brindisi (BDS), approximately 30 minutes away, and Bari (BRI), approximately 1.5 hours away from Lecce. Both airports offer excellent direct flight connections across Europe.
travel.hotels.title: Stay in Lecce
travel.hotels.desc: Lecce offers a wide selection of boutique hotels, B&Bs, and authentic Masserias. We recommend staying near the historic center (Centro Storico) for the best experience.
travel.lecce.title: Discover Lecce
travel.lecce.desc: Famous for its golden baroque architecture, delicious cuisine, and charming streets. Feel free to extend your stay and explore Puglia!
